candidate.rationale: print_u64 performs runtime I/O (println!) with no spec-visible return or tracked-resource effects that can be expressed using existing vstd spec vocabulary. Without an I/O model or ghost observable representing the printed output, no non-vacuous, sound postcondition can be written; the correct choice is to leave it without a spec-level ensures.
risks: Implementation could be changed to panic or perform additional side-effects; clients cannot rely on a spec guarantee.
If future verification requires modeling stdout or I/O ordering, this function will need a revised contract tied to an explicit I/O/trace model.
Hidden nondeterminism in printing (e.g., platform behavior) is not captured, so callers cannot reason about observable effects.
